en: With the basics out of the way, let's dive
into our first set of data structures. And
that would be list and table structures. Or
as I like to put it, arrays and objects on
steroids. Now you'll see why I chose this
summary or subtitle throughout this module.
In this module, we're going to dive into
what list and table structures are actually,
of course. So that we know with what we're
working.
And then we'll build our own list and table
data structures.
We'll build stack and queue data structures
and you will learn what the differences are
and how they work, of course, and when they
might be useful.
And we'll dive into hash tables and build
our own hash table and see where that is
getting used in JavaScript. So let's dive
in.
